components.purpose: Placed as the single top-of-page component to serve as the opening banner; its nested 'Personalized Hero Items' (PersonalizedHeroItem, linked to the Audience personalization list) let you define distinct Heading/Description/CTA text variants — one targeted to a Europe audience entry and one to a North America audience entry — so the banner's text automatically changes based on visitor segment, while visitors who don't match either show the component's default Heading/Description content.
